instruction: Analyze the supplied infrastructure image and return only observable visual evidence relevant to infrastructure condition assessment. Do not invent hidden structural conditions. Do not provide a definitive engineering diagnosis. If evidence is insufficient, explicitly report insufficient evidence.

observations.evidence_type: crack | spallation | efflorescence | exposed_bars | corrosion_stain | surface_condition | other

engineering_decision.reason: Engineering significance and final disposition require qualified human validation.

forbidden_behavior: Do not infer hidden damage not visible in the image.
Do not assign final engineering severity.
Do not convert visual confidence into calibrated probability.
Do not average confidence values from different models.
evidence_principle: Gemini output is one independent evidence source. It must remain distinguishable from domain-CV evidence and must be reconciled through evidence arbitration.
